title: WAL commit-path bundle: widen group-commit window and flush batching
configuration_cause: commit_delay=100us with commit_siblings=2 and wal_writer_flush_after=0 leaves the group-commit window too narrow and the writer flush batch unbounded, so WAL syncs are not coalesced; wal_waiting_backends spikes to 5 in the control block and sync_average_ms reaches 1.17ms.
mechanism: The r004 reversal (commit_delay 0, commit_siblings 5, flush_after 64) was inconclusive: it removed the collection window entirely, so no group commit could form and sync_average_ms stayed ~0.13ms while InsertTweet p95 swung 1.2ms-53ms. The incumbent's 100us window with siblings=2 is too short to collect the 5 terminals' commits. Widening commit_delay to 500us with commit_siblings=3 lets concurrent committers batch into one fsync, and raising wal_writer_flush_after to 256 (8kB units) makes the writer flush in larger batches instead of per-write, reducing sync frequency and wal_waiting_backends queueing.
query_effect: GetUserTweets (88% terminal capacity) is read-dominated and unaffected; InsertTweet commit path shortens, freeing terminal capacity.
expected_tps_effect: Modest increase (0.3-1.5%) if WAL syncs coalesce; neutral if the 5-terminal concurrency is too low to fill a 500us window.

predictions.rationale: Larger group-commit window and flush batch coalesce fsyncs, lowering average sync time.
Fewer syncs means fewer backends queued on WAL.
Shorter commit path frees terminal capacity for GetUserTweets.

alternatives.statement: If the 500us window is too long for 5 terminals, only wal_writer_flush_after batching matters; sync time falls but TPS is unchanged.
WAL sync is already 0.13ms and not the bottleneck; the bundle leaves sync_average_ms and TPS unchanged.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent's 100us window with siblings=2 is too narrow to collect 5 terminals' commits; r004 showed removing the window entirely is inconclusive. A 500us window with siblings=3 plus 256-page writer flush batching is the untested middle amplitude that can actually coalesce fsyncs.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Widen from 100us to 500us within safe [0,1000]; 5x window to collect 5 terminals' commits, still below 1ms added latency.
Raise from 2 to 3 within safe [0,20]; with 5 terminals, 3 siblings reliably triggers group commit without over-gating.
Set from 0 to 256 (8kB units) within safe [0,1024]; 2MB flush batch reduces writer sync frequency versus per-write flushing.

nodes.label: WAL commit-path bundle: commit_delay 500, commit_siblings 3, wal_writer_flush_after 256
Wider group-commit window plus larger writer flush batch coalesce fsyncs
